K8 is MISSING because there is no mention of management conducting an assessment of doubtful receivables provisions or strengthening the finance function as part of governance enhancements. The summary focuses on operational and legal issues but does not address financial governance improvements. The overall coverage is strong for most high-importance criteria, justifying a score of 3 (Generally yes).
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build sequentially without contradiction: the financial deterioration narrative (S1) is supported by specific metric declines (S2-S6), external factors are clearly explained (S7-S10), legal proceedings are chronologically presented (S11-S13), and operational indicators align with the overall distress theme (S14-S17). The concluding statement (S18) logically follows from preceding challenges. No contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues are present. While S17 notes that current assets exceed current liabilities, this does not contradict the liquidity pressures described in S10 and S16 because the summary does not claim these are exhaustive components of the same total, and such discrepancies are common in segment reporting.
